info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Party Asset Validation API
info.description: The Party Asset Validation API facilitates the submission of validation requests for party assets within the banking collateral administration framework. It enables users to verify the eligibility and compliance of assets associated with parties in real-time. Financial institutions and asset managers typically utilize this API to ensure that their asset data aligns with regulatory requirements and internal policies. By automating and streamlining the validation process, clients can enhance operational efficiency and reduce risk in asset management.

post.summary: Create a validation for a party asset.
post.description: This operation allows the user to create a validation for a specific party asset identified by its unique ID. This ensures that the asset meets the necessary compliance and business requirements.
